in_marathi.name: Anita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anita', which means 'graceful' or 'pleasing'. This name holds great significance in Hindu mythology, where Anita is considered to be a manifestation of the Goddess Durga. She is the one who grants grace, beauty, and protection to her devotees.
